content:
maria_sales: FYI — incoming SIG/CAIQ from Horizon Retail. They attached the full questionnaire and asked specifically about KMS/BYOK, logs retention, and a POC timeline for ingesting ~10M docs. Need someone to own questionnaire responses + POC coordination.

alex_se: I can take POC coordination. Quick Q: is this expected on Hosted or Dedicated? BYOK is a blocker either way.

maria_sales: Customer preference is Dedicated (they mentioned private tenancy + SLA in email).

sam_security: Assigning to me for the SIG answers. @alex_se can you pull the KMS/KMS key flow Qs out and DM me the CAIQ sections? We typically need initial answers within 48h for pre-sales. Also need to confirm where audit logs will be retained (customer S3 vs our audited bucket).

leah_pss: Heads-up — BYOK on Hosted generally requires an exception; recommend pushing Dedicated/Private to avoid a security exception. Also request their network diagram + data flow (ingest source).

alex_se: Copying the specific asks here for quick context:
```
- By default we keep keys in customer KMS (BYOK requested)
- Audit logs: 365d retention, customer-owned S3 preferred
- POC: 2-week trial, 10M doc ingest, sample SLA target 99.9%%
```
I'll DM the CAIQ and the form to @sam_security now.

pss_bot: New intake created: https://redwood.support/ticket/PS-12345 — assigned to sales and security, priority: high.

sam_security: Plan: initial SIG answers in 48h, evidence bundle (configs, screenshots, KMS policy snippets) in ~5 days. Need primary security contact at Horizon (email) and confirmation of whether they expect HSM-backed KMS. Please get the network diagram + expected QPS during POC.

alex_se: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Horizon security this afternoon (sending invite now). @maria_sales can you confirm the start week? I penciled Mon Apr 7 for POC start; milestones: 1) infra & keys configured, 2) ingest test, 3) evaluation & handoff.

maria_sales: Confirmed start week Apr 7. I'll handle pricing estimate for Dedicated and share with the customer after we align on infra. Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for status updates. :thumbsup:
